scope: Complete declared offline inspection of all twelve original frozen invoice campaign slots, all 521 bound units and 72 criterion entries. Original failures, uncertainty, rejected responses and earlier pending/post-hoc records are preserved. Selected version/admission fields do not explain endpoint/event/request/SDK independence or the old-delivery companion boundary.
Recorded refusal statuses do not explain all authored payment/binding/state gates or association-versus-eligibility.

Execution/refusal facts remain distinct, but relevant source control flow and causation are explicitly unestablished.
All selected facts and fixed selection were independently reconstructed; unread inventory and unestablished source/provider/business/semantic scope remain explicit.
